description: Summary figure: bilayer-depth profiles, ortholog segment hydropathy, UniProt TM-count inconsistency, basic-loop conservation, hairpin geometry
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, json, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
res=pd.read_csv("ortholog_tm_segments.csv")
slab=json.load(open("slabfit.json"))
geo=json.load(open("hairpin_geometry.json"))

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(14,9))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(2,3,hspace=0.42,wspace=0.3)

# A: membrane depth profile from slab fit
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,:2])
for prot,col in [("MIC26","#2b6cb0"),("MIC27","#dd6b20")]:
    p=slab[prot]["proj"]; pl=slab[prot]["plddt"]
    ks=sorted(int(k) for k in p); z=[p[str(k)] for k in ks]
    ax.plot(ks,z,color=col,lw=1.8,label=prot)
ax.axhspan(-15,15,color="#edf2f7",zorder=0)
ax.axhline(15,color="grey",lw=0.8); ax.axhline(-15,color="grey",lw=0.8); ax.axhline(0,color="grey",ls=":",lw=0.8)
ax.text(2,16,"membrane surface (IMS side)",fontsize=8,color="grey")
ax.text(2,-19,"membrane surface (matrix side)",fontsize=8,color="grey")
ax.set_ylim(-40,45); ax.set_xlim(1,270)
ax.set_xlabel("residue"); ax.set_ylabel("depth z along fitted bilayer normal (A)")
ax.set_title("A. Implicit 30 A bilayer fitted to AlphaFold models: both paralogues cross twice")
ax.annotate("MIC26 TM1\n108-128",(118,3),fontsize=8,ha="center")
ax.annotate("MIC26 turn\n129-135",(132,-24),fontsize=8,ha="center",color="#2b6cb0")
ax.annotate("MIC26 TM2\n136-153",(150,5),fontsize=8,ha="center")
ax.legend(fontsize=9)

# B: ortholog TM1 vs TM2 hydropathy
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,2])
order=["vertebrate_APOO","reviewed","insect_ApoO_family","fungal_ApoO_family"]
for i,g in enumerate(order):
    d=res[res.grp==g]
    ax.scatter(np.full(len(d),i-0.15)+np.random.default_rng(1).normal(0,0.03,len(d)),d.TM1_meanKD,s=18,color="#2b6cb0")
    ax.scatter(np.full(len(d),i+0.15)+np.random.default_rng(2).normal(0,0.03,len(d)),d.TM2_meanKD,s=18,color="#38a169")
ax.axhline(0,color="grey",lw=0.8)
ax.set_xticks(range(4)); ax.set_xticklabels(["vert.\nAPOO","reviewed\nfamily","insect","fungal"],fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel("mean Kyte-Doolittle of mapped segment")
ax.set_title("B. Segment 1 (blue) vs segment 2 (green)\nin 67 ApoO-family orthologs",fontsize=10)

# C: UniProt TM counts across reviewed family
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
names=["MIC27_HUMAN","MIC27_MOUSE","MIC27_BOVIN","MIC27_PONAB","MIC27_CHICK","MIC26_YEAST","MOMA1_CAEEL","MIC26_HUMAN","MIC26_MOUSE","MIC26_BOVIN","YQ75_SCHPO"]
ntm=[2,2,2,2,2,2,2,1,1,1,0]
cols=["#38a169" if n==2 else ("#e53e3e" if n==1 else "#a0aec0") for n in ntm]
ax.barh(range(len(names)),ntm,color=cols)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(names))); ax.set_yticklabels(names,fontsize=7); ax.invert_yaxis()
ax.set_xlabel("UniProt TRANSMEM features (all ECO:0000255)")
ax.set_title("C. TM count across reviewed PF09769 family",fontsize=10)

# D: conservation of the basic turn
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1])
vals=res.turn_basic.value_counts().sort_index()
ax.bar(vals.index,vals.values,color="#805ad5")
ax.set_xlabel("basic residues (K/R) in the turn aligned to MIC26 129-135")
ax.set_ylabel("number of orthologs")
ax.set_title("D. The inter-helix loop is basic in 97%% of orthologs",fontsize=10)

# E: hairpin geometry
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,2]); ax.axis("off")
txt=("E. AlphaFold hairpin geometry\n\n"
     f"MIC26  helix-axis angle {geo['MIC26']['angle']:.0f} deg\n"
     f"       inter-helix PAE  {geo['MIC26']['pae']:.1f} A\n"
     f"       min CA-CA        {geo['MIC26']['min_dist']:.1f} A\n\n"
     f"MIC27  helix-axis angle {geo['MIC27']['angle']:.0f} deg\n"
     f"       inter-helix PAE  {geo['MIC27']['pae']:.1f} A\n"
     f"       min CA-CA        {geo['MIC27']['min_dist']:.1f} A\n\n"
     "180 deg = perfectly antiparallel.\nBoth paralogues: confidently packed\nantiparallel helical hairpin.")
ax.text(0,1,txt,fontsize=9,va="top",family="monospace")
plt.show()
res.to_csv("ortholog_tm_segments.csv",index=False)
print("figure done")
